zh.tpIntro: 先留下一个问题，再手工选入值得一起看的来源。
zh.tpQuestionPlaceholder: 这些材料之间，我想弄清什么？
zh.tpNoQuestions: 还没有问题。可以先写下一个待弄清的问题。
zh.tpDeleteHint: 只删除这个问题及其来源关联，不会删除原笔记或原生对话。
zh.tpNoSources: 尚未选入来源。搜索后先读原文，再决定是否添加。
zh.tpSearchHint: 按文字检索笔记和讨论。结果只是候选，是否相关由你判断，也可以在共创中讨论。
zh.tpDiscussionUnavailable: 当前无法检索讨论；仍可查找笔记来源。
zh.tpReadBeforeAdd: 点击已选来源或搜索结果，核对原文与出处后再添加。
zh.tpSourceMissing: 暂时无法读取此来源。原文可能已移动或更新；可以重试，或移除后重新选择。
zh.tpPendingReference: 这个来源调整尚未保存。已保留你的操作；重试时会以最新来源列表重新应用。
zh.tpStartHint: 在左侧手工新建问题，选入跨文档来源，再按需发起原生共创。成稿时由你新建一篇空白笔记。
zh.tpLoadFailed: 暂时无法载入问题，现有内容已保留。请刷新重试。
zh.tpSaveFailed: 问题未能保存，你的输入和候选操作已保留。请重试。
zh.tpConflict: 问题已在其他窗口更新。已尝试载入最新内容；你的输入和候选操作仍保留，请检查后重试。
zh.tpSearchFailed: 来源搜索暂时失败，请重试。
zh.tpLibraryChanged: 资料库已切换。旧资料库的返回结果已忽略，请刷新当前问题列表。
zh.tpDeleted: 问题已删除，原笔记和对话已保留。

en.tpIntro: Start with a question, then choose the sources you want to consider together.
en.tpQuestionPlaceholder: What do I want to understand across these materials?
en.tpNoQuestions: No questions yet. Write down something you want to understand.
en.tpDeleteHint: This deletes only the question and its source links. Original notes and native conversations are preserved.
en.tpNoSources: No sources selected. Search and read the original before deciding what to add.
en.tpSearchHint: Search notes and discussions by their words. Results are candidates; judge their relevance yourself or discuss them while coauthoring.
en.tpSearchPlaceholder: Words or phrases from your materials…
en.tpDiscussionUnavailable: Discussion search is unavailable. Note sources can still be searched.
en.tpReadBeforeAdd: Select a saved source or search result. Check the original and its origin before adding it.
en.tpSourceMissing: This source could not be read. It may have moved or changed. Retry, or remove it and select it again.
en.tpPendingReference: This source change has not been saved. Your action is preserved and will be reapplied to the latest source list when you retry.
en.tpStartHint: Create a question on the left, choose sources across documents, then coauthor when needed. Create a blank note yourself when you are ready to write.
en.tpLoadFailed: Questions could not be loaded. Existing content is preserved. Refresh to retry.
en.tpSaveFailed: The question was not saved. Your input and proposed action are preserved. Please retry.
en.tpConflict: The question changed in another window. Reloading was attempted. Your input and proposed action remain available; review and retry.
en.tpLibraryChanged: The library changed. Replies for the previous library were ignored. Refresh the current question list.
en.tpDeleted: Question deleted. Original notes and conversations are preserved.
